title: Design System: Baha Eddine Boukhzar — CV

headline.purpose: Section h2.head across About, Experience, Skills, Certifications, Contact.

title.purpose: Company/role name in the experience accordion (.exp-company).

caption.purpose: Italic label above every section headline; the system's one italic use.

body.purpose: Paragraph copy; hero tagline runs slightly larger at 18px.

label.purpose: Nav labels, hero eyebrow, meta-row text, footer quicknav links.

shadows.name: portrait-lift
shadows.purpose: The only structural shadow in the system — grounds the circular headshot.

shadows.name: active-dot-ring
shadows.purpose: Soft halo around the side-rail dot at rest, confirming it as a nav target rather than decoration.

motion.name: reveal-ease
motion.purpose: Scroll-triggered fade/rise (24px) for section content; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: accordion-ease
motion.purpose: Experience row open/close; deliberately unhurried, no spring or overshoot.

motion.name: glow-pulse
motion.purpose: Slow ambient pulse on the hero's radial-gradient glow.

motion.name: field-drift
motion.purpose: Slow rotate/translate drift on the hero's decorative field-line.

components.name: Skill Tag
components.description: Static pill-shaped tag listing a single tool/technology under a skill category.
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-block; font-size: 13px; color: rgba(27,27,25,0.64); border: 1px solid rgba(24,24,22,0.13); padding: 5px 12px; border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; }

components.name: Side Rail Nav Dot
components.description: Fixed vertical nav item: a small dot plus a hover-revealed label tooltip; active state brightens and scales the dot.
components.css: .ds-dot-item { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; } .ds-dot-item button { background: none; border: none; padding: 8px; cursor: pointer; display: flex; align-items: center; } .ds-dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: #9A968A; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(128,124,112,0.18); transition: background .3s, transform .3s; } .ds-dot-item--active .ds-dot { background: #C79A3E; transform: scale(1.5); } .ds-dot-label { position: absolute; left: 26px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: .03em; color: #F3F0E6; background: rgba(20,20,17,0.78); padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 4px; white-space: nowrap; opacity: 0; transform: translateX(-6px); transition: opacity .25s, transform .25s; pointer-events: none; } .ds-dot-item:hover .ds-dot-label { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(0); }

components.name: Text Link
components.description: The system's single interactive-link pattern — used for contact rows, meta text, and certification verify links; a bottom border and gold color appear on hover.
components.css: .ds-link { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 1px solid transparent; transition: border-color .2s, color .2s; } .ds-link:hover { color: #1B1B19; border-color: #A1752B; }

components.name: Accordion Experience Row
components.description: Signature component: a company header that expands to reveal one or more role blocks. Height-animates open via max-height, no chevron rotation.

components.css: .ds-exp-row { border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(24,24,22,0.13); padding: 26px 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-exp-top { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; gap: 20px; flex-wrap: wrap; } .ds-exp-company { font-family: 'Fraunces', serif; font-size: 23px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-exp-when { font-size: 12.5px; color: rgba(27,27,25,0.42); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-exp-body { max-height: 0; overflow: hidden; transition: max-height .5s ease; } .ds-exp-row--open .ds-exp-body { max-height: 900px; } .ds-exp-role { padding-top: 20px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 220px 1fr; gap: 6px 28px; font-size: 14px; color: rgba(27,27,25,0.64); } .ds-r-meta { color: rgba(27,27,25,0.42); font-size: 12.5px; padding-top: 2px; } .ds-r-title { color: #1B1B19; font-weight: 500; margin-bottom: 4px; } .ds-exp-toggle { color: rgba(27,27,25,0.42); font-size: 20px; font-family: 'Fraunces', serif; }

components.name: Portrait
components.description: Circular headshot with a soft ambient halo behind it and the system's one true drop shadow.
components.css: .ds-portrait-wrap { position: relative; width: 112px; height: 112px; } .ds-halo { position: absolute; inset: -18px; background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(212,173,92,0.36) 0%, rgba(212,173,92,0) 72%); filter: blur(4px); } .ds-portrait { position: relative; width: 112px; height: 112px; border-radius: 50%; object-fit: cover; display: block; border: 2px solid #F2F1EA; box-shadow: 0 6px 22px rgba(27,26,22,0.14); }

narrative.overview:
Two dark, ink-black spreads — the opening hero and the closing contact section — frame a long, warm stone-paper interior, the way a print magazine profile opens on a bold cover treatment, settles into readable body pages, and closes on a deliberate final spread. The voice is precise, technical, and engineered rather than decorative: hairline rules, exact stat counts, and an italic-serif caption system do the work that a card grid or drop-shadow system would do elsewhere. Burnished gold is the single accent, held rare enough that its every appearance reads as a deliberate mark, not a color choice.

The system explicitly avoids the vocabulary of a generic SaaS/startup landing page (no card grids, no gradient buttons, no icon-in-a-circle feature blocks) and avoids a "flashy creative portfolio" register (no bold color blocking, no illustration, no playful motion). What replaces those is structure: a fixed side rail acting as a table of contents, hairline dividers standing in for containers, and a two-stage light/dark palette that does the framing a hero image or shadow system would otherwise do.
keyCharacteristics: Two-stage palette: warm stone-paper body, ink-black hero/contact bookends.
Fraunces serif (display/headline/title/caption) paired with Inter sans (body/label) — no third face.
Gold used as a rare signal, never a fill: kickers, italic emphasis, active states, stat numbers.
Depth via ambient glow and hairline rules, not drop shadows or card containers.
A fixed dot-rail side nav functions as both navigation and a live scroll-position indicator.

rules.name: The Rare Gold Rule
rules.body: Gold never fills a shape — no gold buttons, gold backgrounds, or gold badges. It only marks: a kicker word, an italicized name, a stat number, an active dot, a hovered link.

rules.name: The Bookend Rule
rules.body: The night palette is reserved for the hero and contact sections only. Every section in between stays on the stone-paper stage.

rules.name: The One-Italic Rule
rules.body: Italic Fraunces is reserved for kickers and the single emphasized word in the hero name. It never carries a full sentence or paragraph.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Sections, tags, and text blocks carry no shadow. If something needs to feel raised, reach for the ambient glow treatment or a hairline border before reaching for box-shadow.

rules.name: The Told-and-Shown Rule
rules.body: A claim PRODUCT.md calls a genuine differentiator, not just a fact, gets a structural visual device in addition to prose — continuity is a sentence in the About copy and a connected thread in the Experience accordion.

dos: Do treat gold as a mark, not a fill — kickers, one italic word, stat numbers, hover states, the active nav dot.
Do keep the dark palette to exactly the hero and contact sections; every section between them stays on stone-paper.
Do use hairline borders as the default way to separate content — reach for a divider before reaching for a container.
Do let Fraunces own every display/headline/title/caption moment and keep Inter to body copy and labels — no third typeface.
donts: Don't add box-shadow or card-style containers to content sections — depth comes from the ambient glow treatment and hairlines only.
Don't introduce a filled or bordered gold button — no component in this system uses gold as a background color.
Don't round corners beyond the established set (circle, 999px pill, 4px tooltip) — there is no card-radius aesthetic to extend.
Don't set full paragraphs or multi-word headings in italic Fraunces — italic is reserved for kickers and single-word emphasis.
